entries.source:
Welcome!

I am #{italic}##ANTIQUE_WHITE#DarkGod#LAST##{normal}#, the creator of the game and before you go on your merry way I wish to take a few seconds of your time to explain why there are microtransactions in the game.

Before you run off in terror let me put it plainly: I am very #{bold}#firmly #CRIMSON#against#LAST# pay2win#{normal}# things so rest assured I will not add this kind of stuff.

So why put microtransactions? Tales of Maj'Eyal is a cheap/free game and has no subscription required to play. It is my baby and I love it; I plan to work on it for many years to come (as I do since 2009!) but for it to be viable I must ensure a steady stream of income as this is sadly the state of the world we live in.

As for what kind of purchases are/will be available:
- #GOLD#Cosmetics#LAST#: in addition to the existing racial cosmetics & item shimmers available in the game you can get new packs of purely cosmetic items & skins to look even more dapper!
- #GOLD#Pay2DIE#LAST#: Tired of your character? End it with style!
- #GOLD#Vault space#LAST#: For those that donated they can turn all those "useless" donations into even more online vault slots.
- #GOLD#Community events#LAST#: A few online events are automatically and randomly triggered by the server. With those options you can force one of them to trigger; bonus point they trigger for the whole server so everybody online benefits from them each time!

I hope I've convinced you of my non-evil intentions (ironic for a DarkGod I know ;)). I must say feel dirty doing microtransactions even as benign as those but I want to find all the ways I can to ensure the game's future.
Thanks, and have fun!
entries.target:
欢迎！

我是游戏的制造者 #{italic}##ANTIQUE_WHITE#DarkGod#LAST##{normal}#。在愉快的探险开始之前，我希望占用短暂的时间向你解释游戏内购的存在意义。

请不要听到“内购”就惊慌逃跑，听完我的解释再做选择：我本人#{bold}#坚决#CRIMSON#反对#LAST#氪金胜利#{normal}#，因此我保证绝不会做这种事情。

那么，为什么要加入内购呢？马基·埃亚尔的传说是一款便宜/免费的游戏，也不需要会员订阅。它就像我的孩子一样；我非常爱它，并计划为之长久工作（从2009年开始我就一直这么干了！）。但是，为了生存，我仍然需要在现实世界中取得必要的收入。

目前，我提供了以下几种内购项：
- #GOLD#时装#LAST#：除了游戏内现有的种族、物品时装之外，你可以获得更多时装效果，让你看起来更靓！
- #GOLD#氪金速死#LAST#：已经不想玩这个角色了吗？用这个选项来迎接一个帅气的终结吧！
- #GOLD#额外在线仓库格#LAST#：对于捐赠者而言，可以把那些“无用”的捐赠换成更多在线仓库格。
- #GOLD#社区事件#LAST#：服务器会自动触发部分在线事件，而你可以强制让服务器触发特定事件。当然，当前在线的所有玩家都会收到该事件！

我希望这些能说服你，我并没有什么邪恶的想法（虽然我名为DarkGod）。我不得不说，做内购让我感觉很龌龊，即使是上面这些无伤大雅的内购也不例外，但为了游戏的未来，我必须想尽一切办法。
感谢你看到这里，去享受游戏吧！

entries.source:
#GOLD#Necrotic Aura#LAST#
Represents the raw materials for creating undead minions.
It increases each time you or your minions kill something that is inside the aura radius.
entries.target:
#GOLD#死灵光环#LAST#
代表制造亡灵随从的原材料。
每当你或你的随从杀死光环范围内的生物时，原材料就会增加。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Level and experience#LAST#
Each time you kill a creature that is over your own level - 5 you gain some experience.
When you reach enough experience you advance to the next level. There is a maximum of 50 levels you can gain.
Each time you level you gain stat and talent points to use to improve your character.
entries.target:
#GOLD#等级和经验值#LAST#
每次击杀等级高于“你的等级减 5”的生物，你都可以获得一些经验值。
当你的经验值条满时，你可以提升到新的等级。你最多可以提升至50级。
每提升一个等级你将获得属性和技能点数奖励，利用这些点数可以提升你的角色。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Instant Talents#LAST#
Some activated talents take no time to use, being activated with but a thought.
Unlike most talents, instant talents are never put on cooldown from being stunned, and may be usable when most other talents are not.
Specific information on each talent appears its tooltip.
entries.target:
#GOLD#瞬间技能#LAST#
使用有些主动技能不需要时间，瞬间就能发动。
和其他技能不同，瞬间技能不会因震慑而进入冷却状态，并且在大部分技能都不能使用的时候仍有可能使用。
有关技能的详细信息，请参阅技能的提示框。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Willpower#LAST#
Willpower defines your character's ability to concentrate. It increases your mana, stamina, psi capacity, Mindpower, Spell Save, and Mental Save.
entries.target:
#GOLD#意志#LAST#
意志属性是你的专注能力，提升意志可以提升你的法力值、体力值、灵能值上限、精神强度、法术豁免和精神豁免。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Critical chance#LAST#
Each time you deal damage you have a chance to make a critical hit that deals extra damage.
Some talents allow you to increase this percentage.
It is improved by Cunning.
entries.target:
#GOLD#暴击率#LAST#
每次造成伤害时，你都有一定几率造成一次附带额外伤害的暴击。
一些技能可以提高这个几率。
提升灵巧属性值可以提高暴击率。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Ammo remaining#LAST#
This is the amount of ammunition you have left.
Bows and slings must be reloaded when this reaches 0, which you will do automatically each turn you rest or don't perform a non-movement action.
Alchemists use specially prepared gems as ammunition to throw bombs, which must be reloaded manually.
entries.target:
#GOLD#弹药剩余#LAST#
表示你剩余的弹药数量。
弓和投石索在弹药耗尽的时候必须装填；在你休息、原地等待或只进行移动的每个回合，都会自动装填。
炼金术士使用特殊的炼金宝石来作为弹药使用，必须手动装填。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Vim#LAST#
Vim represents the amount of life energy you control. Each corruption talent requires some.
It does not regenerate naturally; you need to drain it from yourself or your victims.
Each time you kill a creature you gain 50% of your Willpower + 1 as Vim.  This value is multiplied by the rank of the creature.
If you can't pay for the Vim cost of a talent you may instead pay with life at a rate of 200% of the Vim cost.
entries.target:
#GOLD#活力#LAST#
活力是你控制的生命能量。施放堕落系法术需要消耗活力值。
活力值不会自动回复，你需要从你自身和你的目标身上吸取。
每杀死一个生物可以吸收意志属性50%+1的活力值，该数值会乘以该生物的分级。
如果你无法支付使用一个技能的活力值，你可以改为支付生命值，数额为活力值消耗的200%。

entries.source: Found the Blood of Life and the four unique inscriptions: Primal Infusion, Infusion of Wild Growth, Rune of Reflection and Rune of the Rift.
entries.target: 获得生命之血与四种特殊刻印：原初之纹身、纹身：野性生长、反射符文、符文：时空裂隙。

entries.source: Caught the attention of overpowered greater multi-hued wyrms in Vor Armoury. Perhaps fleeing is in order.
entries.target: 在沃尔军械库引起了超强的七彩龙精英的注意。也许，离开是最好的主意。

entries.source: Killed the seven overpowered wyrms in the "Room of Death" in Vor Armoury.
entries.target: 在沃尔军械库的“死亡之屋”杀死7只超强的七彩龙精英。

entries.source: Died on the Eidolon Plane.
entries.target: 在艾德隆位面死亡。

entries.source: Had the golem kill a boss while its master was already dead.
entries.target: 当傀儡杀死BOSS时，炼金术士已死亡。

entries.source: Burnt to the ground
entries.target: 焚烧殆尽

entries.source: Killed the leaders of the Orc Pride.
entries.target: 杀死兽人部落的首领。

entries.source: Won ToME by preventing the Void portal from opening.
entries.target: 成功阻止虚空传送门开启，通关ToME。

entries.source: Won ToME by closing the Void portal using Aeryn as a sacrifice.
entries.target: 以艾琳为祭品关闭虚空传送门，通关ToME。

entries.source: Fought the two Sorcerers without closing any invocation portals.
entries.target: 在未关闭任何召唤传送门的情况下与两名巫师交战。

entries.source: Fought the two Sorcerers and closed four invocation portals.
entries.target: 与两名巫师交战并关闭了4扇召唤传送门。

entries.source: Killed the Orc Greatmother in the breeding pits, thus dealing a terrible blow to the orc race.
entries.target: 在兽人育种棚中杀死巨型兽人母体，给兽人一族带来了沉重打击。

entries.source: Both killed your future self and got killed by your future self.
entries.target: 既杀死过未来的自己，也曾被未来的自己杀死。

entries.source: Killed the weaver queen and the temporal defiler.
entries.target: 杀死织网蛛后和时空污秽魔。

entries.source: Finished the whole Abashed Expanse zone without being hit by a single void blast or manaworm. Dodging's fun!
entries.target: 通关整个次元浮岛，全程未被任何一次虚空爆炸或法力蠕虫命中。闪避真有趣！

entries.source: Destroyed the naga portal in the slazish fens and got caught in the after-effect.
entries.target: 在斯拉伊什沼泽摧毁娜迦传送门，并被卷入了它的余波。

entries.source: Some walk in shadow, alone, unloved, unwanted. What powers they wield may be mighty, but their names are forever cursed.
entries.target: 有些人行走于阴影之中，孤独、无人关爱、不被需要。他们掌握的力量或许强大，但他们的名字永远受到诅咒。

entries.source: Affliction can run to the soul, and hatred can fill one's entire being. Overcome someone else's hated curse to know its dreaded meaning.
entries.target: 痛苦可以深入灵魂，憎恨可以充斥整个身心。战胜他人身上那可憎的诅咒，方能领会其可怕的含义。

entries.source: Worse, any who approach the Cursed can be driven mad by their terrible aura.
entries.target: 更可怕的是，任何接近被诅咒者的人，都可能受其可怕光环的影响而发狂。

entries.source: They can channel the power of the Sun to smite all who seek to destroy the Sunwall.
entries.target: 他们能引导太阳之力，痛击一切试图摧毁太阳堡垒的人。

entries.source: They can channel the power of the Sun and the Moons to burn and tear apart all who seek to destroy the Sunwall.
entries.target: 他们能引导太阳与月亮之力，灼烧并撕裂一切试图摧毁太阳堡垒的人。

entries.source: Masters of Sun and Moon magic, they usually burn their foes with Sun rays before calling the fury of the stars.
entries.target: 他们是日月魔法的大师，通常先用太阳射线灼烧敌人，再召唤群星之怒。

entries.source: Exploiting a hole in the fabric of spacetime, Chronomancers learn to pull threads from other timelines into their own.
entries.target: 通过利用时空结构上的孔洞，时空系修习者学会了将其他时间线的丝线拉入自己的时间线。

entries.source: Pulling these threads creates tension and the harder they pull the more tension is produced.
entries.target: 拉动这些丝线会产生张力，拉得越用力，产生的张力就越大。

entries.source: The most powerful corruptors can even take on some demonic aspects for themselves.
entries.target: 最强大的腐化者甚至能让自己具备某些恶魔特征。

entries.source: Alchemist
entries.target: 炼金术士

entries.source: An Alchemist is a manipulator of materials using magic.
entries.target: 炼金术士是使用魔法操纵物质的人。

entries.source: Alchemists can transmute gems to bring forth elemental effects, turning them into balls of fire, torrents of acid, and other effects.  They can also reinforce armour with magical effects using gems, and channel arcane staffs to produce bolts of energy.
entries.target: 炼金术士能转化宝石，产生火球、酸液洪流等元素效果。他们还可以利用宝石为护甲附加魔法效果，并通过奥术法杖发射能量弹。

entries.source: Though normally physically weak, most alchemists are accompanied by magical golems which they construct and use as bodyguards.  These golems are enslaved to their master's will, and can grow in power as their master advances through the arts.
entries.target: 炼金术士通常体质孱弱，但大多数炼金术士身边都有亲手建造的魔法傀儡充当保镖。这些傀儡服从主人的意志，并会随着主人技艺精进而变得更加强大。

entries.source: Most Archmagi lack basic skills that others take for granted (like general fighting sense), but they make up for it by their raw magical power.
entries.target: 大多数元素法师缺乏他人习以为常的基本技能（如基本的战斗意识），但他们能凭借纯粹的魔法力量来弥补。

entries.source: Shadowblades are Rogues that are touched by the gift of magic, able to kill with their daggers under a veil of stealth while casting spells to enhance their performance and survival.
entries.target: 影舞者是拥有魔法天赋的盗贼，能在潜行的掩护下用匕首杀敌，同时施展法术增强战斗和生存能力。

entries.source: They use the schools of Phantasm, Temporal, Divination and Conveyance magic to enhance their arts.
entries.target: 他们使用幻术、时空、侦查和传送系法术来增强自身的技艺。

entries.source: The wilds of Maj'Eyal are not a safe place. Untamed beasts and wandering dragons may seem a great threat, but the true perils walk on two legs. Thieves and brigands, assassins and opportunistic adventurers, even mad wizards and magic-hating zealots all carry danger to those who venture beyond the safety of city walls.
entries.target: 马基·埃亚尔的野外不是个安全的地方。野兽和到处游荡的龙似乎是巨大的威胁，然而真正危险的是两条腿的人。窃贼、强盗、刺客、投机冒险家、疯狂的巫师，甚至憎恶魔法的狂热者，都会给那些走出安全城墙的冒险者带来危险。

entries.source: Amidst this chaos wanders one class of rogue that has learned to take by force rather than subterfuge. With refined techniques, agile feats and brawn-backed blades the Marauder seeks out his targets and removes them by the most direct methods. He uses dual weapons backed by advanced combat training to become highly effective in battle, and he is unafraid to use the dirtiest tactics when the odds are against him.
entries.target: 在这片混乱之中，游荡着一类学会了以武力而非诡计夺取所需的盗贼。凭借精湛的技巧、敏捷的身手和蛮力加持的刀刃，掠夺者搜寻目标，并以最直接的方式将其除掉。他们以高等战斗训练为后盾双持武器，在战斗中极具威力；形势不利时，他们也不惮使用最卑劣的手段。

entries.source: While able to take maximum advantage of their sling by using deft movements to avoid and confuse enemies that try to get close, the Skirmisher truly excels when fighting other ranged users.
entries.target: 虽然散兵能借助灵巧的移动躲避并迷惑试图接近的敌人，从而最大程度地发挥投石索的威力，但他们真正擅长的是与其他远程单位作战。

entries.source: They have mastered the use of their shield as well as their sling and are nearly impossible to defeat in a standoff.
entries.target: 他们既精通投石索，也精通盾牌的使用，在远距离对峙中几乎无人能击败他们。

entries.source: A good Bulwark is able to withstand terrible attacks from all sides, protected by her shield, and when the time comes lash out at her foes with incredible strength.
entries.target: 优秀的盾战士能凭借盾牌的保护承受来自四面八方的猛烈攻击，并在时机到来时以惊人的力量向敌人发起反击。

entries.source: Natural abilities can go beyond mere skill. Experience the true powers of nature to learn of its amazing gifts.
entries.target: 自然之能可以超越单纯的技艺。体验自然的真正力量，领略它奇妙的恩赐。

entries.source: They can take on the aspects of creatures, summon creatures to them, feel the druidic call, ...
entries.target: 他们可以获得各种生物的特质、将生物召唤到身边、感受德鲁伊的召唤……

entries.source: They have access to talents normally belonging to the various kind of drakes.
entries.target: 他们能使用通常属于各类龙的技能。
